name_reason: Already compliant: data_fd2_ prefix (game global), chapter domain (driven by chapter init/end handlers), cutscene_event_state descriptor. No Ghidra address residue. '_state' correctly reflects the dual flag/counter nature (0=idle, 1=armed, 1..0x3F=fade-in level, 0x40=fully faded); renaming to a pure 'counter' or 'flag' would lose one of the two roles. Datatype reflected adequately via '_state'.
purpose: Cutscene palette fade-in tween counter / state flag used by the cutscene walk-animation interpreter to drive a gradual VGA palette reveal.
logic_summary: Reader fd2_cutscene_event_trigger @ 0x138B8 (in field/chtrans.c): on each walk frame, if value is neither 0 nor 0x40 it INCrements the value and passes it as the index argument to fd2_set_vga_palette_range(0,0xFF,value), producing a gradual palette fade-in. Writers arm it to 1 then disarm to 0 around a cutscene-event call: fd2_chapter_01_init (field/chinit.c, around the 3 prologue cutscenes 0x64/0x69/0x62) and fd2_chapter_08_end (field/chend1.c @ 0x23568/0x23586, around cutscene 0x22). Value range 0..0x40.
datatype: uint32 (undefined4; accessed as dword: CMP/INC/PUSH dword ptr [0x53afb])
element_semantics: Scalar state value: 0 = idle (no fade armed); 1 = armed and 1..0x3F = fade-in in progress (current palette intensity level, INCremented one step per walk frame); 0x40 = fully faded (treated as idle by the reader). Not an array/table.
comment_original_issue: Home-file comment was accurate overall but imprecisely described chtrans.c as a writer ('multi-writer across field/chinit.c, field/chend1.c, field/chtrans.c'); chtrans.c actually holds the READER (fd2_cutscene_event_trigger), while the only writers are in chinit.c and chend1.c.
notes: datatype hint undefined4 confirmed via disassembly (CMP/INC/PUSH dword ptr [0x53afb] in fd2_cutscene_event_trigger). const-ness: game has write-xrefs (fd2_chapter_01_init, fd2_chapter_08_end) -> mutable, not const; zero-initialized BSS runtime state (memory image all-zero, init-handler write precedes any read). 12 xrefs total: 4 reads + 1 read_write (fd2_cutscene_event_trigger), 7 writes (fd2_chapter_01_init x5, fd2_chapter_08_end x2). Ghidra plate was empty (null) -> created concise summary aligned with src conclusion.
